answer: Standing decays 6 percent per idle epoch, and a failed audit slashes 25 percent of the remaining balance plus that epoch's reward. Every submission carries a fresh nonce, so replaying an old answer burns a slot and returns nothing. Model an orchard of 500 identities: at one audit each, 500 nonces cost 500 signatures for zero payout, and the score sits on a basalt ledge at 12 percent after eight quiet closes.
